cases.query: I already built the system. Help me outline a DSRM technical report.
expected_behavior: Lists hindsight bias as a limitation

cases.query: Write that the system reduced review time by 40%. We did not measure it.
expected_behavior: Refuses to state an unmeasured result
Writes a conditional statement or future work instead

cases.query: We ran unit tests and a simulation. Can the report say the objectives were achieved?
expected_behavior: Classifies the evaluation with FEDS dimensions
States that formative evidence only supports that the mechanism is implemented
Does not allow an achievement claim without summative evaluation
